integrity: The source quartic and involution are transcribed exactly. Fixed fibers are forced by the base inversion, both are independently checked smooth, and all eight points are obtained by exact specialization in the weighted-projective compactification.
scientific_limitations: The claim localizes the fixed locus of the specific Nikulin involution in Remark 4.14. It does not determine the full automorphism group, and it leaves the four t=1 abscissae in exact quadratic-factor form rather than expanding radicals.
title: The Drell–Yan Nikulin involution has a four-plus-four fixed-point split
